newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Macedonia begins compulsory polio vaccination.
newsitem.headline: Macedonia begins compulsory polio vaccination.

text.p: Macedonia launched a mandatory vaccination programme for children on Monday after an outbreak of polio in neighbouring Albania, health officials said.

Health ministry officials also announced that "all citizens from Macedonia travelling to Albania must show certificates that they have been immunised against polio at least 15 days prior to their trip."
No cases of polio have been reported in Macedonia since 1987 and the ministry said it did not expect an epidemic to break out in municipalities on the Macedonia-Albania border.

But authorities, assisted by the World Health Organisation (WHO), adopted the measures to prevent the spread of polio to the former Yugoslav republic amid reports of a rise in polio cases in Albania and other Balkan states.
